accepted.quote: It would remove states' rights under section 401 of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (commonly known as the Clean Water Act, or CWA) (33 U.S.C. 1341) to issue Water Quality Certificates to natural gas pipeline projects that discharge into their navigable waters.
accepted.bill: H.R. 3668, the Improving Interagency Coordination for Pipeline Reviews Act
accepted.rationale: The legislator criticizes removing state Clean Water Act certification authority, indicating support for protecting state water quality standards.
